### How It Works
- **C (`gcc`)**: Uses `#if 0 ... #endif` preprocessor blocks to skip the Python triple-quoted string delimiters (`r""" "` and `" """`, with paired quotes on each line so the C lexer stays valid inside `#if 0`) as well as the Python implementation at the bottom. The C implementation [`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j7ebnks2/polyglot/main.py.c#L8-L41) uses base-$10^9$ big-integer addition so it matches Python's arbitrary-precision output even for large $N$.
- **Python (`python3`)**: Treats `#if 0` and `#endif` as comments and wraps the entire C source block inside a raw multiline string `r""" " ... " """`, then executes [`fib`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-j7ebnks2/polyglot/main.py.c#L49-L55) on `sys.argv[1]`.
